rows.text: Sheoldred does both halves of a sacrifice deck at once: she reanimates a creature for free on your upkeep, and she makes every opponent sacrifice one on theirs. So the deck is built out of creatures that WANT to die — Kokusho, Junji, Archon of Cruelty — and outlets to kill them on your own terms. Bring one back every turn, cash it in for value, repeat.

rows.name: Sheoldred, Whispering One
rows.text: 6/6 with swampwalk, a free reanimation every one of your upkeeps, and a forced sacrifice on every opponent's upkeep. Seven mana, and she is worth every one of them.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a graveyard enabler and acceleration. Entomb plus Reanimate is a turn-two Archon of Cruelty, which is faster than casting Sheoldred and better than waiting for her.
Sheoldred is a seven-drop. Crypt Ghast, Sol Ring and Jet Medallion are what make her a turn-five play. Do not keep a hand that only works if you draw four more lands.

Sacrifice on your upkeep, not your main phase. Sheoldred's trigger reanimates first — so put Kokusho back, then sacrifice it during your turn, then do it again next upkeep. Killing it before the trigger wastes a whole turn of value.

rows.name: Grave Pact
rows.text: with Sheoldred out this is the lock. Their upkeep edict plus your sacrifice outlet means every opponent loses two creatures per turn cycle and cannot rebuild.
